 Senegal is celebrating its first ever gold medal in an Olympic event in the country's national sport, beach wrestling. Elisabeth Diatta, aged 16, has defeated Japan's Reisa Kojima at the Youth Olympic Games in front of home fans. The local variation of wrestling is called laamb and is a cultural staple. Diatta, from the Casamance region where women traditionally wrestle, hopes her win inspires Senegalese girls. Her coach, Isabelle Sambu, sees this as a symbol of opportunity. Shortly after Diatta's victory, Senegalese wrestler Maguette Diop also won gold in the men's 80-kilogram final.

 SALY, Senegal (AP) — Senegal won its first ever gold medal at an Olympic event on Saturday in the country's national sport, beach wrestling.
 Elisabeth Diatta, 16, beat Japanese opponent Reisa Kojima at the Youth Olympic Games with a spectacular takedown in the final of the women's 55-kilogram division in front of home fans.
